rubrics.justification: The response overcalls the image as a clearly expanded high-quality 3AA blastocyst with a distinct dense ICM and cohesive TE, but the image appears more ambiguous/partially collapsed with poorly defined ICM and TE, so several described features are not convincingly visible.
It integrates age, prior IVF outcome, sperm parameters, lifestyle, and highlights important data inconsistencies (AMH/DOR and COCs/MII), though some links to prognosis are somewhat generic.

The reasoning is generally structured and internally consistent, but it relies heavily on the provided 3AA label despite weak image support and makes some speculative inferences (e.g., prior failure implications, residual smoking effects).

SET recommendation and attention to luteal support/endometrial assessment are guideline-consistent, but suggesting ERA after a single failed transfer and framing RIF workup this early is not well aligned with current evidence-based practice.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, confirming endometrium, luteal support, and clarifying discrepant lab data, though some suggested investigations may be premature.
